stock.description: V.S. International Group Limited operates primarily as an investment holding company, focusing on the production and distribution of plastic molded items and their constituent parts. Its business activities are organized into three principal divisions: plastic injection and molding, the assembly of electronic goods, and the design and fabrication of moulds. The company also engages in the manufacturing, assembly, trading, and sale of various electronic products, components, and parts. Additionally, it produces and sells plastic injection molds and is involved in managing and operating rooftop solar power facilities. V.S. International Group Limited conducts its operations across a broad international footprint, with significant presence in Hong Kong, Mainland China, Europe, the United States, and Southeast Asia. Established in 1997, the company's headquarters are situated in Central, Hong Kong. It functions as a subsidiary of V.S. Industry Berhad.
